title: Remove a student from a class

handbook.what: Taking a student off a class roster, for a pupil who has changed set or joined the wrong class from a shared link.
handbook.where: The class page, the **Remove** button at the end of the student's row in the roster.
how: Find the student in the roster.
Tap **Remove** at the end of their row.
handbook.note: The student keeps their account and everything they have learned, and they can join another class straight away. Only their place on this roster goes.
